entries.display_title: The Astonishing Thousand Sunny and Usopp's Tearful Apology!
entries.synopsis: The crew prepares to leave Water Seven, but Usopp's return remains unresolved. Garp's cannon fire gives the Straw Hats little time to settle their differences.
